report:
### Sample adequacy
- 12 fields analysed, 12 white cells counted. Count is too small for a differential (fewer than 100 white cells: differential is only indicative; below 20, comparison with reference ranges is not applicable).
- Red cells: 132 counted (~11.0/field); platelets: 5 counted (~0.4/field). No empty fields.
- Note: 1 uncertain detection kept only because its field had no sure white cell.

### Differential (indicative only, n=12)
- Automated counts: neutrophils 4 (33.3%), lymphocytes 3 (25.0%), monocytes 2 (16.7%), eosinophils 2 (16.7%), basophils 1 (8.3%), IG 0, erythroblasts 0.
- Count too small to assess against reference ranges; interpret as indicative only.

### Review list
- Review queue: 2 cells marked for review.
- **Flagged to open first:**
  - Cell 2 (field-02.png, monocyte, conf 0.99) — **high priority**: uncertain detection — may not be a white cell at all; please verify if cell is present.
  - Cell 1 (field-01.png, neutrophil, conf 0.96) — marked for review; second opinion agreed (neutrophil) — confirm morphology.

### Limits
- Second-opinion vision model is generalist (65% on single cells, weak on IG/erythroblasts vs classifier 97.6%); disagreements prompt human review, not corrections. Red-cell count is indicative in crowded fields; reference ranges are indicative adult ranges — lab ranges prevail.

known_limits: The second opinion model is a generalist: 65 % right on single PBC cells, weak on ig and erythroblasts (experiment 01). The classifier is 97.6 % right on the same data (experiment 05).
Red cells are undercounted on crowded fields (experiment 14); the red cell count is indicative.
Reference ranges are indicative adult ranges; the lab's own ranges prevail.
